name: paydlux check
description: Metered preflight for 402 endpoints: POST the URL before your agent pays and the endpoint's own payment terms are fully parsed — payee, asset, issuer, network, amount — or flagged unreadable rather than silently accepted. PAYABLE / NOT_PAYABLE / REFUSED verdict with an on-chain receipt, settled on Stellar mainnet (0.08 XLM). Open source, MIT.
